source: Alem etal2015Table1 andFigure6; original2017permeability relation only
bound_derivation: For 0<=D<1, r(D)=(1-sqrt(D))^-3 >=1+h_min*D. Integrate resistance over the same full bed to obtain Keff/K0<=1/(1+h_min*mean(D)). h_min is the minimum of [r(D)-1]/D. Stationarity gives2s^3-8s^2+12s-3=0.
limitations: Nominal consistency check; not a statistical rejection test.
Mass/pressure measurements must cover the same bed and same loading endpoint; published term overall is used but precise external pressure reference requires author clarification.
Reported initial hydraulicconductivity variability is about7%; individual ratio measurement uncertainties are not supplied.
Hydraulic conductivity and intrinsicpermeability ratios coincide only at matched fluidviscosity/density; diluteviscosity correction here is small but not silently omitted from simulations.
Finite-bin resistance estimate assumes B uniform within each measured bin; global bound does not require this assumption.
Reported drymass and turbidimetric mass balances have experimental errors; observations are not forced to close exactly.
